sentences.zh: 这药没什么区别。

items.title: Blackouts and water shortages in Kyiv after Russia strikes Ukraine’s energy grid

sentences.en: Blackouts and water shortages in Kyiv after Russia strikes Ukraine’s energy grid.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯袭击乌克兰能源网后，基辅停电和缺水。

sentences.en: Moscow used 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles in attacks on electricity substations and bridge over the Dnipro Volodymyr Zelenskyy has accused Russia of trying to “plunge Kyiv and the entire country into a blackout”, after a major attack overnight on energy infrastructure in the capital and a bridge over the Dnipro River.
sentences.zh: 莫斯科使用172架无人机和36枚弹道导弹袭击了第聂伯河上的变电站和桥梁Volodymyr Zelenskyy指责俄罗斯试图“使基辅和整个国家陷入停电” ，此前一夜之间对首都的能源基础设施和第聂伯河上的一座桥梁进行了重大袭击。

sentences.en: Ukraine’s president said Moscow’s preparations for peace talks next week involved pummelling a city of millions with ballistic missiles.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰总统表示，莫斯科为下周的和平谈判做准备涉及用弹道导弹打击数百万人的城市。

sentences.en: Continue reading..

items.title: Court rules against Home Office in asylum seeker kidnapping case

sentences.en: Court rules against Home Office in asylum seeker kidnapping case.
sentences.zh: 法院裁定内政部在寻求庇护者绑架案中不予受理。

sentences.en: Department had claimed that being kidnapped for ransom was not exploitation of trafficking victims in case of Syrian man abducted in Libya The court of appeal has rejected claims by the Home Office that being kidnapped for ransom is not exploitation of trafficking victims.
sentences.zh: 该部门声称，在利比亚绑架叙利亚男子的案件中，被绑架索取赎金并不是对贩运受害者的剥削。上诉法院驳回了内政部的指控，即被绑架索取赎金并不是对贩运受害者的剥削。

sentences.en: The ruling means that many people who have been kidnapped for ransom, whom officials have previously excluded from being victims of exploitation under trafficking rules, will now have to have these claims considered.
sentences.zh: 该裁决意味着，许多被绑架勒索赎金的人（官员此前已根据人口贩运规则将其排除在剥削受害者之外）现在将不得不考虑这些索赔。

sentences.en: They may be eligible for the support and recovery package trafficking victims are entitled to.
sentences.zh: 他们可能有资格获得贩运受害者有权获得的支持和康复套餐。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Home Office sued after stripping almost 1,500 EU citizens of right to live in UK

sentences.en: Home Office sued after stripping almost 1,500 EU citizens of right to live in UK.
sentences.zh: 内政部在剥夺了近1500名欧盟公民在英国的生活权后提起诉讼。

sentences.en: Campaign group the3million lodges court papers after EU citizens told pre-settled status was an ‘error’ The Home Office is being sued for alleged breach of the Brexit withdrawal agreement after stripping almost 1,500 EU citizens of their full rights to live in the UK.
sentences.zh: 在欧盟公民告诉预先确定的地位是一个“错误”之后， 300万人提交了法庭文件。内政部在剥夺了近1500名欧盟公民在英国生活的全部权利后，因涉嫌违反英国退欧协议而被起诉。

sentences.en: Campaign group the3million lodged papers at the high court on Friday after several cases emerged of EU citizens who were granted pre-settled status to remain in the country after Brexit but were told recently those decisions were an “error”.
sentences.zh: 在英国脱欧后被授予预先定居地位的欧盟公民的几起案件出现后， 300万人于周五在高等法院提交了文件，但最近被告知这些决定是一个“错误”。

items.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle under house arrest after child sex abuse material charge

items.title: What’s the point? Ten years after the Paris treaty, are climate talks getting anywhere?

sentences.en: What’s the point?
sentences.zh: 有什么意义？

sentences.en: Ten years after the Paris treaty, are climate talks getting anywhere?.
sentences.zh: 《巴黎条约》签署十年后，气候谈判是否取得了进展？

sentences.en: Its key temperature goal has been missed but experts say the agreement is still proving a vital moral compass for progress It was a curious way of conducting negotiations.
sentences.zh: 其关键的温度目标已被错过，但专家表示，该协议仍被证明是进步的重要道德指南针。这是进行谈判的一种奇怪方式。

sentences.en: Ahead of the 2025 climate summit, in the Amazonian port of Belém last year, the Brazilian hosts had taken off the table the issue that most had assumed would be at its heart: concrete plans from each country laying out exactly what they would be doing to cut their greenhouse gas emissions.
sentences.zh: 在2025年气候峰会之前，去年在亚马逊的贝伦港，巴西的房东们已经摆脱了大多数人认为的核心问题：每个国家的具体计划，确切地说明了他们将采取哪些措施来减少温室气体排放。

sentences.en: Brazil was insisting, instead, that these plans – the bedrock of the Paris agreement – were the business of national governments and not up for negotiation.
sentences.zh: 相反，巴西坚持认为，这些计划--《巴黎协定》的基石--是各国政府的事，而不是谈判。

sentences.en: “In that case, it will be a very short Cop,” one seasoned global south negotiator told the Guardian shortly before, reflecting a widespread unease.
sentences.zh: “在这种情况下，这将是一个非常短的警察，”一位经验丰富的全球南方谈判代表不久前告诉《卫报》，反映出普遍的不安。

sentences.en: “There is nothing to negotiate.” Continue reading..
sentences.zh: “没有什么可谈判的。”继续阅读。

items.title: Ousted Paraguay president under house arrest after banking crisis leaves 60% of country unable to access accounts

sentences.en: Ousted Paraguay president under house arrest after banking crisis leaves 60% of country unable to access accounts.
sentences.zh: 在银行危机导致60%的国家无法访问账户后，巴拉圭总统被软禁。

sentences.en: Santiago Peña was detained minutes after he was impeached by Congress, as protesters took to the streets demanding answers after the suspension of the Ueno bank Paraguay’s rightwing president has been placed under house arrest minutes after he was impeached by Congress, amid a severe crisis that left more than half the country’s population unable to access their bank accounts.
sentences.zh: 圣地亚哥·佩尼亚（ Santiago Peña ）在被国会弹劾几分钟后被拘留，当时抗议者走上街头要求回答，因为上野银行巴拉圭右翼总统在被国会弹劾几分钟后被软禁，而严重的危机使该国一半以上的人口无法访问他们的银行账户。

sentences.en: Santiago Peña is being investigated about allegations he used his political influence to favour a bank that expanded exponentially under his government and was suspended this week after irregularities .
sentences.zh: 圣地亚哥·佩尼亚（ Santiago Peña ）正在接受调查，指控他利用自己的政治影响力支持一家在政府领导下成倍扩张的银行，该银行本周因违规行为而被停职。

items.title: Beyond code generation: A developer’s guide to agentic engineering

sentences.en: Beyond code generation: A developer’s guide to agentic engineering.
sentences.zh: 超越代码生成：代理工程开发人员指南。

sentences.en: This October, GitHub saw more than 1.2 billion commits in one week over 400% more than a year earlier.
sentences.zh: 今年10月， GitHub在一周内比一年前增加了400 ％ ，超过12亿次提交。

sentences.en: This is more commits than GitHub received in all of 2025.
sentences.zh: 这比GitHub在2025年全年收到的承诺更多。

sentences.en: Chances are, you re generating more code than you were a year ago.
sentences.zh: 很有可能，您生成的代码比一年前多。

sentences.en: But ask yourself: do you feel 400% more productive than you were last year?
sentences.zh: 但问问自己：你觉得自己比去年提高了400%的工作效率吗？

sentences.en: Building software takes more than a good prompt.
sentences.zh: 构建软件需要的不仅仅是一个好的提示。

sentences.en: As AI speeds up implementation, software developers are feeling more pressure in other places: a Faros AI study found that pull requests spent 441% longer in review when teams went from low to high AI adoption.
sentences.zh: 随着人工智能加速实施，软件开发人员在其他地方感受到了更大的压力： Faros人工智能研究发现，当团队从低到高的人工智能采用率时，拉取请求的审查时间延长了441%。

sentences.en: As a software developer, you gather requirements and steer implementation, review changes and evaluate test results, then investigate what happens in production.
sentences.zh: 作为软件开发人员，您可以收集需求并指导实施，审核更改和评估测试结果，然后调查生产过程中会发生什么。

sentences.en: Agents can help you work more efficiently across all of these stages: Plan, Build, Verify, and Observe.
sentences.zh: 客服代表可以帮助您更有效地完成所有这些阶段的工作：规划、构建、验证和观察。

sentences.en: We ll walk through what an effective agentic engineering workflow looks like on GitHub.
sentences.zh: 我们将介绍GitHub上有效的代理工程工作流程。

sentences.en: Plan: Get everyone and every agent on the same page See if this sounds familiar.
sentences.zh: 计划：让每个人和每个客服代表了解情况，看看这是否听起来很熟悉。

sentences.en: You re planning an API change.
sentences.zh: 您正在计划API更改。
